en.html:
She did not ask for full death make-up. But at least she would wipe her lips—

That was the plan. For some reason it would not work.

One look, and there was no mystery. The right arm was already gone.

en.html:
A grumble that did not even amount to self-mockery. A bitter smile that did not even amount to resentment.

She had reached her <ruby>goal<rt>・・</rt></ruby>. But it had meant nothing, if this was the fate waiting for her.

Season a tragedy with a little futility and it turns into a comedy.
...All that was left was to laugh. Weakly.

Something seemed to answer.

—Oh, it is nothing. I am about to <ruby>begin<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> in earnest, you see, so I thought I would open with something lively.

Still, <ruby>this<rt>・・</rt></ruby> one has no refinement. I shall seal it away for the time being—

If that was not a hallucination, then no words could have made a greater plaything of human beings. For in that voice there was not even the wish to play with them. The will to play was <ruby>absent<rt>・・</rt></ruby>.

As a spring storm scatters cherry blossoms, it simply crushed people underfoot, with no effort at all.

It was an evil god.

A grumble that did not even amount to self-mockery. A bitter smile that did not even amount to resentment.

She had reached her goal・・. But it had meant nothing, if this was the fate waiting for her.

Season a tragedy with a little futility and it turns into a comedy.
...All that was left was to laugh. Weakly.

Something seemed to answer.

—Oh, it is nothing. I am about to begin・・・ in earnest, you see, so I thought I would open with something lively.

Still, this・・ one has no refinement. I shall seal it away for the time being—

If that was not a hallucination, then no words could have made a greater plaything of human beings. For in that voice there was not even the wish to play with them. The will to play was absent・・.

As a spring storm scatters cherry blossoms, it simply crushed people underfoot, with no effort at all.

It was an evil god.

ja.html:
自嘲にもならない愚痴。
　怨嗟にもならない苦笑。

　<ruby>目的<rt>・・</rt></ruby>は達した。
　しかし、何の意味もなかった――こんな運命が待ち
受けていたのでは。

　悲劇に徒労というスパイスを効かせれば喜劇になる。
　……笑うしかない。力なく。

　何者かが、それに応えたようだった。

　
　――なに。
　そろそろ本腰を入れて<ruby>始める<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>のでな。一つ景気良く
やってみようと思ったのだ。

　
　とはいえ、どうも<ruby>これ<rt>・・</rt></ruby>は雅趣に欠ける。
　これは、ひとまず封じておくか――

　それが幻聴でなかったなら、さまでに人を玩弄した
物言いもなかったろう。
　何故ならそこには、玩弄するという意思さえ<ruby>無い<rt>・・</rt></ruby>のだ。

　春の嵐が桜を吹き散らすように。
　ただ、事もなげな振舞いで人間を踏み砕く。

　悪神であった。
